resources.string: AI is optional; separate permission is requested before use.
Read about account and data use below. Optional AI has a separate choice.
Account, cloud, sharing and device permissions

Rights and requests on the web
Choosing a request opens an email draft. No cards, files or account identifiers are attached automatically; nothing is sent until you send it. Do not include passwords or verification codes.
Rights depend on applicable law. You do not need a new account or AI permission to contact us. Requests are handled by the publisher; this is not an automatic export tool.

Hello, I would like to make a REAL data request: %1$s.

My request:

Relevant REAL account (if needed):
Country (optional, to identify the applicable process):

Please explain secure verification and the next steps.
REAL is published by Çağrı Gül. Contact cagrigull@outlook.com for privacy requests. Reading or closing this screen does not grant AI permission.

Firebase supports sign-in/security; Cloudflare supports card sync, files and sharing. Necessary account, content and technical information may be processed outside your country. AI permission is separate from cloud sync.

Locally interpreted commands send no AI interpretation request. Unresolved voice commands and Mood use Groq; film, TV and game discovery may use Gemini or Groq. You make separate feature choices and can revoke them in Settings → AI and privacy.

Android speech-to-text may use the network depending on your device provider; AI interpretation is separate. Selected files and an explicitly chosen contact are used; choosing a person does not bulk-upload your address book.
Anyone who has a public card/calendar link can open its shared content. Calendar invitees may see a link placed in the description. REAL connections and board membership use separate access rules.

Manage accounts offers cloud erasure or account deletion. Cloud erasure preserves local cards and suspends sync until backup is explicitly restarted. Account deletion is separate. Withdrawing AI permission does not automatically erase previous transfers.

Android automatic app backup and raw device transfer are disabled for REAL data. REAL account sync is separate. Local-only books and unsynced files do not automatically transfer to a new phone; keep your document copies.

Local books/files may remain on your device. Cards, share copies, caches and technical records have different retention purposes. Expiry of a link does not erase all original files. Erasure can show pending until server cleanup is complete.

Request access, a copy, correction, erasure or objection. Applicable rights depend on your country; language does not determine your rights. Reading this notice or granting AI permission does not itself establish international-transfer safeguards.

For commands not understood locally, REAL sends transcript alternatives, language/time zone/date, category names and limited context for the last relevant card and up to 15 cards (IDs, titles, categories, times, repeats and status) to its server. Groq interprets the command to help create or edit cards.

Your selected mood, descriptions and factors, plus previous titles for a new suggestion, go to the REAL server. Groq creates suggestions. A limited number of previous artist/song titles for this account is also sent to reduce repetition; that history is stored on the device.
Selected genres, feelings, game platforms and skipped titles go to the REAL server. Google Gemini or Groq selects suggestions; titles/artwork are verified through catalogs.
The connection test sends sample commands through REAL to Google Gemini or Groq, not your cards or speech.
If a command cannot be interpreted on your device, your transcript and necessary card context are sent to the external AI service Groq. AI can make mistakes.
Your selected mood and suggestion preferences are sent to the external AI service Groq. AI suggestions can be wrong.
Your selected filters and previous suggestion titles are sent to external AI services Google Gemini or Groq. AI suggestions can be wrong.
A sample request is sent to Google Gemini or Groq to check connectivity. Your cards are not sent.
Optional. Turn it off at any time in Settings → AI and privacy.
Information goes from your device to REAL and then Groq. These features do not automatically switch to another AI provider if Groq fails.
Requests go through REAL to Google Gemini or Groq.
REAL and AI providers may process information outside your country. Commands interpreted locally send no AI interpretation request. Android speech-to-text and cloud sync are separate operations.

REAL sends information needed for the operation. When enabled for the relevant feature, Groq Zero Data Retention (ZDR) disables input/output retention for reliability and abuse monitoring. Technical usage metadata may remain. Saved REAL cards and local suggestion history are separate.

Processing and retention depend on provider terms and account settings. Unpaid Gemini terms may allow product improvement using submitted content. Do not add personal or sensitive information to this flow.
This AI command request does not send raw audio, photos or saved card location names to Groq. Your transcript may contain private information. Android speech recognition has separate data terms.
Recent song artists/titles are stored locally per account to reduce repetition. Up to 32 songs are sent to Groq for new music suggestions. This history is not included in cloud sync.
Revoke this feature permission in Settings → AI and privacy. You can keep using REAL without AI. Turning AI permission off does not disable cloud sync or erase information already sent.
